tactics: induction l <;> intro i h <;> cases i <;> simp_all

induction l with
| nil => simp
| cons a t ih =>
  intro i h
  cases i with
  | zero => cases t <;> simp_all
  | succ k => simp_all [List.eraseIdx_cons_succ]

intro i h <;> induction l generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all
